newsitem.title: UK: LIFFEE coffee futures end mixed on Friday.
newsitem.headline: LIFFEE coffee futures end mixed on Friday.

text.p: Nearby robusta coffee futures were softer at the close on Friday but forwards were slightly firmer on industry covering with switches dominating most of the session's activity, traders said.
At the close on Friday, the benchmark November contract was down $1 at $1,505 a tonne after touching a session low of $1,494 a tonne.
The January contract was up $4 at a session high of $1,452 a tonne.
Turnover on the exchange reached 3,211 lots.
"There was a reasonable amount of switching going on," said one trader.
But aside from switches, activity was pretty routine.
"There was not much buying underneath, and not much selling overhead," added the trader.
